retrievalProfile.description: A dark, symmetrical sunburst emblem featuring organic flame-like rays over a complex geometric mandala background with central Roman numeral focus.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, multi-layered circular emblem consisting of a dark grey geometric mandala base, overlaid with a ring of curved, red-gradient flame-like rays, and anchored by a stylized Roman numeral 'IV' in the center. The entire composition is set against a solid black background with a subtle grainy texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric layering of geometric and organic shapes
Radial symmetry emanating from a central typographic mark
High contrast between deep red gradients and dark grey patterns
Sharp, pointed terminals on all outer elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally positioned, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height and width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central Roman numeral 'IV' acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Outward radial movement from the center to the tips of the flames, then circling the geometric background patterns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive solid black negative space surrounding the central emblem to emphasize its isolation and power.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (Flame rays and central numeral)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value overall; saturation is concentrated in the red gradients which transition from a muted crimson to near-black.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with thick verticals
Integrated into the central circular void
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' has a hooked left terminal and a sharp, elongated right terminal
The 'I' features a wedge-shaped top and bottom
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone central mark; no secondary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Gothic or Blackletter inspired Roman Numerals
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the dark, sharp aesthetic of the surrounding graphics.
The letters are integrated into the symbol's geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical dark grey geometric mandala on a black background, overlaid with a radial burst of curved, flame-like rays featuring a deep red to black gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a custom-drawn Roman numeral 'IV' in the center, using a sharp, gothic-influenced serif style with the same red gradient as the flames.

verificationChecks: Do the red gradients transition smoothly to black?
Are the terminals of the letters and flames sharp and pointed?
Is the background mandala visible but subordinate to the red elements?

mustRedesign: Exact replica of the 'IV' glyph shape
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the central numeral is legible despite stylization.
Ensure the red gradient does not wash out against the black.
Verify the geometric mandala is centered behind the flames.
Check for consistent sharpness across all pointed elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: A [central symbol] in [red gradient] style, centered over a [dark grey geometric mandala], set against a [solid black background] with [radial symmetry].
